description: This file contains the PHP class `ReturnReason` within the namespace `Opencart.Admin.Model.Localisation`. It manages CRUD operations for return reasons in the Opencart e-commerce system, including adding, editing, deleting, and fetching return reasons and their descriptions, as well as managing cache related to return reasons.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: This class provides methods for managing return reasons, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return reasons and their descriptions within the Opencart system.

methods.name: addReturnReason
methods.description: Adds a new return reason to the database and its multilingual descriptions, and clears related cache.

methods.name: editReturnReason
methods.description: Edits an existing return reason identified by its ID and updates its descriptions.

methods.name: deleteReturnReason
methods.description: Deletes a return reason from the database and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasonsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reasons associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnReason
methods.description: Retrieves a return reason by its ID, including its language-specific data.

methods.name: getReturnReasons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return reasons filtered and sorted based on provided criteria.

methods.name: getReturnReasonsCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of return reasons for the current language setting.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a return reason in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return reason ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return reason descriptions that match a specific language ID.
